title: Write an Honest Affiliate Recommendation Around a Tool You Actually Use
description: An affiliate recommendation is more useful when it answers a real buying question. Start with a tool you genuinely use, explain what you use it for, and include the limitations that matter to the reader. Put the disclosure near the recommendation rather than hiding the relationship. Check the current product details separately before sharing a link. This is a writing exercise, not an endorsement of any tool shown in the image. Explore TDIE on Skool. Images are AI-generated.
